## About
SCW Performance runs a retail performance shop and a JDM RHD auto dealership in Carrollton, central to Dallas, Ft. Worth, Plano, Irving, Denton and the rest of DFW. The shelves are stocked with hard to find performance parts, accessories, JDM wheels and fabrication supplies for Honda, Acura, Nissan and Toyota.
We also bring in classic Japanese vehicles that can be lawfully imported and driven in the U.S. Jeremy helps buyers find a car and walks them through the process, and Luigi handles the shop work. Please call ahead for vehicle showings. They are by appointment only.
You'll find us next to Lumber Liquidators, on the side facing Broadway Street. Take the Beltline Rd exit, head toward Sandy Lake/Whitlock on the service road, and turn into the Lumber Liquidators lot. We're at the far end of the building on the left. Rated 4.1 from 144 Google reviews.

## Services
- Imported Japanese 25-Year Classic Vehicles: Right hand drive cars imported from Japan and driven before they ship. Call ahead, showings are by appointment only.
- USED JDM Wheels: Used wheels sourced from Japan, plus help choosing the right tire and wheel sizes.
- JDM OE Parts: Original equipment parts from the Japanese market.
- Engine Performance: Engine performance parts for JDM Honda, Acura, Nissan and Toyota.
- Air Suspension: Air suspension parts alongside our regular suspension stock.
- Engine repair / Maintenance: Shop work to get a car ready for its new owner: engine repair and maintenance, performance upgrades, tires, wheels, and paint and body repairs. Quoted for your exact needs at additional cost.

## FAQ
Q: Can a right hand drive JDM car be imported to the U.S.?
A: Yes. Under the NHTSA and Customs rules, a motor vehicle that is at least 25 years old can be lawfully imported without regard to FMVSS compliance.

Q: Can you ship a car to me?
A: Yes. We can ship any of our cars directly to your door in any of the 48 contiguous states. Hawaii and Alaska are excluded. Contact us for a quote.

Q: Do your cars come with a warranty?
A: No. Because of their age, the cars are sold as-is. Any repairs we perform at the buyer's expense carry a 30-Day warranty on parts and labor.

Q: Where is a car stored if it isn't old enough to import yet?
A: We offer free storage of your vehicle until it turns 25 years old and can be shipped out, and we take care of it while it waits.
